approved_by.evidence: Explicit request to implement the next BH-03 phase section by section, merge one pull request, synchronize main, and delete the feature branch.

authorized_scope: Acquire exactly the three artifacts accepted by the Phase 2 pre-acquisition gate.
Verify bounded response metadata, exact bytes, SHA-256 integrity, and the WebAssembly structural contract before publishing artifact bytes.
Publish the experimental Popcorn startup descriptor and start one isolated runtime attempt.
Load the accepted application bundle and expose bounded generation-correlated readiness.
Classify acquisition, startup, bundle-load, cancellation, and readiness failures and release attempt-owned resources.
Publish versioned Phase 3 conformance fixtures, validation, and completion evidence.
not_authorized: shared runtime registry or runtime reuse
root registration, mount, update, move, disposal, or remount lifecycle
shutdown, runtime-loss recovery, retry orchestration, or fallback execution
browser-profile composition or active browser results
renderer, component, Phoenix, Plug, or server command behavior
resource or reliability measurements and BH-03 acceptance
public API stability, package publication, or support claims
